say:13:1460120010:1.text: Well, it's a pleasure to meet you. Are you here to sightsee or to trade? I happen to be free at the moment and can help.

say:14:1460120011:1.text: After completing introductions, you gently explain Wilder and Mauler customs to Sinbad.
say:14:1460120011:1.source_cn: 你们为辛巴达介绍了潘，又不得不为他科普了一些关于绿裔和...

say:15:1460120012:1.text: You wait until Bols finishes serving and everyone's plates are full before you finally explain the purpose of the trip.
say:15:1460120012:1.source_cn: 直到波尔斯把菜上齐，你们才总算对辛巴达解释清楚了你们的来意。

say:16:1460120013:1.text: A tournament? Well, you found the right guy!
say:16:1460120013:1.source_cn: 什么？比赛？这你们可找对人了！

say:17:1460120014:1.text: Well, Maulers... can't say I've had the pleasure, savvy? But boxing matches? Ah, old Rustport has the finest and most professional establishments in all the seven seas...
say:17:1460120014:1.source_cn: 那什么蛮血部落我是不太清楚，但你要说拳赛，全世界都没有...

say:18:1460120015:1.text: From organizing events to finding boxers, the Carmine Whispers have been handling these delicate matters for years.
say:18:1460120015:1.source_cn: 从组织赛事到参赛选手，血薇帮弄了多少年了！

say:19:1460120016:1.text: Let's finish this fine meal, and I'll take you to find Sonja and her crew.
say:19:1460120016:1.source_cn: 快吃，吃完我带你们去找索尼娅他们！

say:24:1460120018:0.text: What do you think, Sonja? An interesting proposition, right?
say:24:1460120018:0.source_cn: 就是这么回事，索尼娅！是不是很有意思？

say:25:1460120019:0.text: Well, I've only heard about the Maulers recently, but if <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s vouching for them, I'm sure the tournament is serious.

say:26:1460120020:1.text: If we get a standout performance... Well, that's free publicity for Rustport. And in our business, reputation's everything.
say:26:1460120020:1.source_cn: 如果能在这样的大赛上崭露头角，也能帮锈锚港打个广告吧。

say:27:1460120021:1.text: My hands are tied right now... too many fires to put out. How about you go, Lucca? Go show them what Rustport stands for.
say:27:1460120021:1.source_cn: 只是我这边事务繁多，不便动身，卢卡，你去参赛如何？

say:29:1460120022:0.text: Oh, right! Lucca was the boxing champion around these parts! If you participate, it'll definitely impress Brutus and the other Maulers!
say:29:1460120022:0.source_cn: 对哦，卢卡可是拳赛的冠军！如果你能参赛，你的拳击肯定能...

say:32:1460120023:1.text: Thanks, but that champion title's ancient history. These days, keeping Rustport running is what I focus on.
say:32:1460120023:1.source_cn: 多谢夸奖，只是冠军名号已经是多年以前的事了，对我而言，...

say:33:1460120024:1.text: Come on, Lucca, think of it as a vacation. Working so much isn't good for you.
say:33:1460120024:1.source_cn: 哎呀，就当去散散心嘛，二当家，老是干活多没意思。

say:34:1460120025:1.text: Don't talk to me like you know me. You're not even a part of Carmine Whispers...
say:34:1460120025:1.source_cn: 别这么叫我，你又不是血薇帮的成员。

say:35:1460120026:1.text: Hey, don't sweat the small stuff. Life is all about adventure, comforts, and buffets. So, go out there and live!
say:35:1460120026:1.source_cn: 无所谓，冒险完之后就去旅馆——就和吟游诗人唱的一样，这...

say:36:1460120027:1.source_cn: 你要是真这么闲，码头上倒是有不少货要卸，我可以给你派单子。

say:38:1460120029:1.text: Look, Lucca, you know I like to make jokes and everything, but this is a real opportunity here. This is a worldwide tournament. Think about it! You against the world!
say:38:1460120029:1.source_cn: 卢卡，刚刚是开玩笑，但你不去真有些可惜啊，那可是世界范...

say:43:1460120032:1.text: According to what you just said, as long as one passes a qualifying round, they can join the main event, but then every two-bit fighter will think they belong in the big leagues. There's going to be too many fighters.
say:43:1460120032:1.source_cn: 按照你们刚刚说的，只要通过一场预选赛，就能拿到参赛资格...

say:46:1460120033:1.text: Ah, those were different times... It was when the Carmine Whispers were still at war with the Water Wights. I remember we had to go through 10 rounds of matches before getting to the main event.
say:46:1460120033:1.source_cn: 是的，我有印象，当时甚至血薇帮还在和水鬼帮争斗，大赛都...

say:47:1460120034:1.text: All that vetting meant nothing when half the real talent got stuck fighting nobodies in the prelims. A waste of good fighters, and worse, a waste of the crowd's patience.
say:47:1460120034:1.source_cn: 再怎么选拔，初赛也还是乌烟瘴气，有实力的选手不少都在前...

say:48:1460120035:1.text: So, we created top contenders or seeded fighters, and then this system was born.
say:48:1460120035:1.source_cn: 所以，王牌选手，或者种子选手，随便你怎么叫，总之这个制...

say:49:1460120036:1.text: Proven fighters with rankings bypass prelims at our discretion. First round? Maybe. Finals? For the right pedigree. We don't waste good talent on warm-ups.
say:49:1460120036:1.source_cn: 前代取得名次，证明过实力的选手，可以跳过预赛、初赛，甚...

say:50:1460120037:1.text: I got it. In the tournament that <style="stress"><player_name></style> mentioned, the number of participants you beat in the qualifying rounds can be used as proof!
say:50:1460120037:1.male: I got it. In the tournament that <style="stress"><player_name></style> mentioned, the number of participants you beat in the qualifying rounds can be used as proof!
say:50:1460120037:1.female: I got it. In the tournament that <style="stress"><player_name></style> mentioned, the number of participants you beat in the qualifying rounds can be used as proof!

say:51:1460120038:1.text: The more people you beat here, the more rounds you can skip. If you beat all of them, you can become a top contender and go directly to the main event!
say:51:1460120038:1.source_cn: 拿到越多的人，可跳过的轮次越多，如果全部收集，就能成为...

say:52:1460120039:1.text: ... This way, in order to be qualified for the main event, there will also be a continuous stream of fighters coming to Rustport from all over the world.
say:52:1460120039:1.source_cn: 这样一来，为了得到资格，也会有源源不断的选手从各地来到...

say:53:1460120040:1.text: Since <style="stress"><player_name></style> brought Master Pang all the way here, why don't we let him watch and judge an exhibition match between all of us?
say:53:1460120040:1.male: Since <style="stress"><player_name></style> brought Master Pang all the way here, why don't we let him watch and judge an exhibition match between all of us?
say:53:1460120040:1.female: Since <style="stress"><player_name></style> brought Master Pang all the way here, why don't we let him watch and judge an exhibition match between all of us?

say:54:1460120041:1.text: From among us, he can decide on a gatekeeper for the qualifiers.
say:54:1460120041:1.source_cn: 让他来评点看看，谁更适合来成为预选赛的守擂人！

say:55:1460120042:1.text:
Did you come all this way to provoke a fight or something...?
Whatever, let's get this over with.
say:55:1460120042:1.source_cn: 哼，无聊的挑衅。\n我接受了。

say:56:1460120043:1.text: Let's have the three of us team up and start the Rustport Regional Qualifiers!
say:56:1460120043:1.source_cn: 那么，我们三个就暂时搭档下，现在就来开始简单直接的锈锚...

choice:39:0:1.text: To qualify you need to do this...
choice:39:0:1.male: To qualify you need to do this...
choice:39:0:1.female: To qualify you need to do this...

say:3:1460122001:1.text: Sinbad strikes with the eyes of the hawk. His blade is able to easily find its mark, for he reads the battlefield like an open scroll.
say:3:1460122001:1.source_cn: 辛巴达的进攻非常精准，而这是建立在他对战场及时的观察和...

say:4:1460122002:1.text: His intuition guides his hand. When one strikes a weak point, and even danger must yield.
say:4:1460122002:1.source_cn: 犹如直觉一般选择目标，并异常冷静地击中破绽，在被围攻时...

say:5:1460122003:1.text: This is a boarding technique I learned from the women who raised me. It's even more powerful when I'm fighting on a ship.
say:5:1460122003:1.source_cn: 这是妈妈们教过我的接舷战技巧，在船上作战时威力会变得更强。

say:6:1460122004:1.text: The two Carmine Whispers move like twin dragons in flight... where one strikes, the other guards. No opening escapes their unity.
say:6:1460122004:1.source_cn: 血薇帮的二位攻防一体的联手作战浑然一体，简直毫无破绽。

say:7:1460122005:1.text: The Carmine Oath isn't just words; it's blood promise. We fight as one, and Lucca's war cry could wake the dead. Makes even me want to charge into hell.
say:7:1460122005:1.source_cn: 这是血薇的誓约，我将守护战场的同伴。而卢卡的战吼也始终...

say:8:1460122006:1.text: You all are very suitable for group battles or situations where the few are against the many.
say:8:1460122006:1.source_cn: 几位的战斗，都非常适合群战或者以少对多的场合。

say:11:1460122007:1.text: Well, in that case, let's just let the challengers form teams of about five in the qualifying round.
say:11:1460122007:1.source_cn: 嗯，既然这样，干脆预选赛的擂台就让挑战者们自行组个五人...

say:12:1460122008:1.text: As for the other rules, let's go back and discuss everything carefully.
say:12:1460122008:1.source_cn: 至于赛制，我们回去再慢慢商讨章程。

say:13:1460122009:1.text: Also, if they pass, I'll prepare a special ship to send them to the tournament.
say:13:1460122009:1.source_cn: 唔，如果通过考验，我这边准备专门的船只送他们去参加大赛。

say:14:1460122010:1.text: This is Rustport's first step to officially open itself up to the world.
say:14:1460122010:1.source_cn: 这是锈锚港正式展现风采的第一步。

say:15:1460122011:1.text: Then I'll escort... No, I'll steer the ship!
say:15:1460122011:1.source_cn: 那就由我来护航——不，我来开船！

say:16:1460122012:1.text: Ha! With your skills, I don't know if you can even pass the preliminaries.
say:16:1460122012:1.source_cn: 哼，就凭你这点本事，能不能通过预选还不一定呢。

say:17:1460122013:1.text: I won't go easy on you. You have to get through me first.
say:17:1460122013:1.source_cn: 我可不会放水，不管你想参赛还是护航，都得过了我这关。

say:18:1460122014:1.text: So, you're personally going to be in charge of the prelims?
say:18:1460122014:1.source_cn: 所以，预选赛这边就由索尼娅你亲自负责了？

say:19:1460122015:1.text: I'll check my schedule, but me and Lucca can take turns.
say:19:1460122015:1.source_cn: 嗯，到时看看日程，我和卢卡轮换进行。

say:20:1460122016:1.text: Also, winning the early rounds means nothing if they can't fight as a team. Rustport's reputation ain't getting tarnished because some hothead can't follow orders.
say:20:1460122016:1.source_cn: 不过，预选赛后，我们这边的参赛者还是需要统一带队，否则...

say:21:1460122017:1.text: I have to stay here in case the Dead Tide Fleet comes back, but if you pass, you can help Lucca lead the fighters.
say:21:1460122017:1.source_cn: 我会留在这里坐镇，防止死潮舰队卷土重来，如果到时你能通...

say:22:1460122018:1.text: Don't worry, the great Captain Sinbad and Lucca the Bonecrusher are going to give the outside world a taste of the real Rustport!
say:22:1460122018:1.source_cn: 放心，伟大的船长辛巴达和血薇帮的铁拳卢卡会给外面的世界...

say:23:1460122019:0.text: Amid mirth and warm companionship, you converse at length on the rules of combat and the nature of the tournament.
say:23:1460122019:0.source_cn: 在笑声中，你们又探讨了不少战斗与比赛的规则。

say:24:1460122020:1.text: The pleasant discourse draws to a brief close, for Sonja is called away to attend a pressing engagement.
say:24:1460122020:1.source_cn: 直到索尼娅不得不前去处理会议，愉快的交谈才暂时告一段落。

say:29:1460122021:0.text: Just now Sinbad said that he would bring some local specialties.
say:29:1460122021:0.source_cn: 刚刚辛巴达还说，会顺便带上特产货物。

say:30:1460122022:1.text: This way, if the tournament is a success, not only will the Ashen Wastes start welcoming more tourists, but people will start coming to Rustport again!
say:30:1460122022:1.source_cn: 这样一来，如果大赛能成功举办，不止荒角沙漠会迎来游客，...

say:31:1460122023:0.text: Unfortunately, because of the Dead Tide Fleet, the people here still have to guard against the Graveborn pirates...
say:31:1460122023:0.source_cn: 可惜这边还是要防着死潮舰队的那些亡灵……

choice_prompt:32:1460122023.text: Unfortunately, because of the Dead Tide Fleet, the people here still have to guard against the Graveborn pirates...
choice_prompt:32:1460122023.source_cn: 可惜这边还是要防着死潮舰队的那些亡灵……

say:35:1460122024:1.text: I have heard the name... but only in ancient scrolls that speak of the Bantus Empire.
say:35:1460122024:1.source_cn: 我曾经有所耳闻，但只是在很古老的手记里提到过班题斯帝国...

say:36:1460122025:1.text: As for the Graveborn, my knowledge comes from only legends and ghost stories.
say:36:1460122025:1.source_cn: 至于亡灵这种生物，我的了解就只来自于传奇故事——或者说...

say:40:1460122026:1.text: Yes, they're basically the same as what's written in ghost stories… Oh, I have an idea!
say:40:1460122026:1.source_cn: 其实鬼故事里写的基本也差不离……对了！我有个主意！

say:41:1460122027:1.text: They've been talking about improving the image of the Graveborn. If we have some friendly Graveborn come, it could work!
say:41:1460122027:1.source_cn: 说到想要与外界接触，改善亡灵形象，友善的亡灵来——

choice_prompt:42:1460122027.text: They've been talking about improving the image of the Graveborn. If we have some friendly Graveborn come, it could work!
choice_prompt:42:1460122027.source_cn: 说到想要与外界接触，改善亡灵形象，友善的亡灵来——

say:43:1460122028:1.text: But they all prefer peace and quiet... They may not want to participate in such a lively tournament.
say:43:1460122028:1.source_cn: 不过，他们都喜好宁静，深居简出，不一定会答应参加这种热...

say:44:1460122029:1.text: It doesn't hurt to ask! And we can introduce Master Pang to some real Graveborn!
say:44:1460122029:1.source_cn: 先去问问意见嘛！至少，也能让潘见见真正的亡灵！

choice:42:0:1.text: I was thinking the same thing!
choice:42:0:1.male: I was thinking the same thing!
choice:42:0:1.female: I was thinking the same thing!

narration:0:1460123001:1.text: To see all preparations completed in haste, you politely, though with some regret, decline the invitation from Sinbad and Bols to drink through the night.
narration:0:1460123001:1.source_cn: 为了尽早达成邀请，你们不得不忍痛拒绝了辛巴达和波尔斯的...

narration:2:1460123002:0.text: With haste, you depart for Cedartown and proceed directly to the Radinov Manor...
narration:2:1460123002:0.source_cn: 动身前往雪松镇，直奔拉季诺夫庄园的遗址……

say:3:1460123003:0.text: By chance, as you arrive, you find Carolina and Callan already entertaining familiar faces...
say:3:1460123003:0.source_cn: 很巧的是，卡列琳娜和铐兰也正在招待着客人们……

say:5:1460123004:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>! It's good to see you again, but why are you here? Oh, and we have another guest!
say:5:1460123004:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>! It's good to see you again, but why are you here? Oh, and we have another guest!
say:5:1460123004:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>! It's good to see you again, but why are you here? Oh, and we have another guest!

say:6:1460123005:0.text: It just so happens that Lady Valka and Viscount Ludovic are here as well. Why don't you all sit down and have a cup of tea with us?
say:6:1460123005:0.source_cn: 正好，瓦丽卡和子爵先生也在，大家坐下来喝一杯下午茶吧？

say:7:1460123006:0.text: In the comfort of Carolina's hospitality, you partake in the exquisite flower tea and delicacies presented by Viscount Ludovic, then proceed to disclose the reason for your visit...
say:7:1460123006:0.source_cn: 在卡列琳娜的招待下，你们享用了柳博米尔带来的美味花茶和...

say:12:1460123007:0.text: Truth be told, we were but breaking bread and sharing tea, pondering our course henceforth until thy sudden arrival.
say:12:1460123007:0.source_cn: 不瞒你们，我们在这里聚餐喝茶，也是在考虑接下来的行动—...

say:13:1460123008:1.text: As <style="stress"><player_name></style> said, this presents a grand opportunity for us Graveborn to reveal ourselves unto the world.
say:13:1460123008:1.male: As <style="stress"><player_name></style> said, this presents a grand opportunity for us Graveborn to reveal ourselves unto the world.
say:13:1460123008:1.female: As <style="stress"><player_name></style> said, this presents a grand opportunity for us Graveborn to reveal ourselves unto the world.

say:14:1460123009:1.text: Yes, it would also be most beneficial if qualifying matches could be set up here.
say:14:1460123009:1.source_cn: 嗯，尤其是预选赛制度，如果能在这里设立一处预选赛的比赛...

say:15:1460123010:1.text: And here I thought Lord Ludovic hated noisy battles.
say:15:1460123010:1.source_cn: 咦？我还以为柳博米尔先生你不喜欢吵吵闹闹的战斗。

say:16:1460123011:1.text: No, you're right. I hate them. That's why I would like Carolina to organize the qualifiers and screen the participants.
say:16:1460123011:1.source_cn: 我确实不喜欢。所以，我想建议的是，由卡列琳娜负责组织预...

say:17:1460123012:1.text: Valka can participate in the tournament, so someone needs to stay here to keep things in line.
say:17:1460123012:1.source_cn: 瓦丽卡应该会去参赛，那么这里总需要留人驻守的。

say:21:1460123014:1.text: Indeed, I remember you saying you wish to reshape the legacy that Whiteridge has long held of the Graveborn.
say:21:1460123014:1.source_cn: 嗯，我记得你说过，想要改变白山对于亡灵流传千百年的认知。

say:22:1460123015:1.text: I think personally organizing, promoting, and taking charge of the qualifying matches for the main tournament will further advance your aspirations.
say:22:1460123015:1.source_cn: 而亲自组织、宣传并负责一场大赛的预选赛，我想，更能推进...

say:23:1460123016:1.text: Carolina is much like yourself, Lord Ludovic. She finds solace in silence and shuns the clamor of company. Best to let the matter rest.
say:23:1460123016:1.source_cn: 卡列琳娜和你一样，喜欢安静，也不爱和人打交道，还是算了。

say:24:1460123017:1.text: If need be, I shall assume responsibility.

say:25:1460123018:1.text: No, Valka, thank you for thinking of me, but I want to give this a try.
say:25:1460123018:1.source_cn: 不，瓦丽卡姐姐，我明白你的好意，但我想来试试。

say:26:1460123019:1.text: Like I just said, let's team up and compete with <style="stress"><player_name></style> first.
say:26:1460123019:1.source_cn: 就像刚刚说的那样，先由我们联手与<style=stre...
say:26:1460123019:1.male: Like I just said, let's team up and compete with <style="stress"><player_name></style> first.
say:26:1460123019:1.female: Like I just said, let's team up and compete with <style="stress"><player_name></style> first.

say:27:1460123020:0.text: Let Master Pang evaluate if I'm qualified to host the screening of the fighters.
say:27:1460123020:0.source_cn: 让这位潘先生点评一下，我是否有相应的资格，来主持这场筛选。

say:33:1460123022:0.text: No, Callan, this is a tournament. I need to do this myself.
say:33:1460123022:0.source_cn: 不，哥哥，这是参赛者的切磋，所以，我需要亲自站出去。

say:39:1460123024:1.text: Okay, if I get the qualification to host the preliminaries, my brother can be the defender in the first few rounds.
say:39:1460123024:1.source_cn: 那么，等我拿到主持预选赛的资格后，就由哥哥来担任一环的...

say:40:1460123025:1.text: With Carolina's gentle yet unwavering insistence, Callan ultimately consents to her request.
say:40:1460123025:1.source_cn: 在卡列琳娜温和而坚定的劝说下，铐兰终于同意了要求。

say:43:1460123026:1.text: Wait! I have a most worthy comrade for this contest.
say:43:1460123026:1.source_cn: 等等！我这里还有一位非常适合参赛的伙伴——

say:44:1460123027:1.text: I can invite Igor and we'll take up arms together.
say:44:1460123027:1.source_cn: 我去把伊戈尔喊来，一起作战！

say:3:1460124001:1.text: Lady Valka moves like one long tempered by war.
say:3:1460124001:1.source_cn: 很有趣的组合。瓦丽卡女士看起来是身经百战的出色将士。

say:4:1460124002:1.text: Refined through endless practice. Precise. Ideal for leading troops into battle.
say:4:1460124002:1.source_cn: 每个动作都千锤百炼，无比准确，尤为适合率军突击。

say:5:1460124003:1.text: Then do you mean I am ill-suited for the trials of the tournament?
say:5:1460124003:1.source_cn: 呃，就是说在擂台战这种环境上不太适合吗？

say:6:1460124004:1.text: No, this tournament is very different from the traditional fight competitions.
say:6:1460124004:1.source_cn: 不，这次的比赛与传统所谓的擂台对战多有不同。

say:7:1460124005:1.text: On my path, I've seen many ways to fight and many who live by the blade.
say:7:1460124005:1.source_cn: 一路走来，我也看到了各种各样的战技，目睹了各种各样的选手。

say:8:1460124006:1.text: Although your open style may be held back in certain battles...
say:8:1460124006:1.source_cn: 尽管你大开大合的风格或许在部分比赛中会遭到克制。

say:9:1460124007:1.text: ...I believe your way of combat will bring surprises to many.
say:9:1460124007:1.source_cn: 但我相信，你堂皇的战斗方式也一定会带来惊喜。

say:10:1460124008:1.text: In other words, Valka is suitable to participate in the main tournament.
say:10:1460124008:1.source_cn: 也就是说，瓦丽卡姐姐很适合去外面参赛了？

say:11:1460124009:1.text: That is correct. Also, your magic, Lady Carolina, is very worthy for battle.
say:11:1460124009:1.source_cn: 正是如此，而卡列琳娜小姐你的魔法也是同样。

say:12:1460124010:1.text: You control your foes like the wind bends the grass. Alone, you strike swiftly. With others, you become an unstoppable storm, mastering both attack and defense.
say:12:1460124010:1.source_cn: 能轻易控制住敌人，又能加以攻击，如果与人协作，无论攻还...

say:13:1460124011:1.text: And what of Igor, then? Though he may be slightly chaotic at times...
say:13:1460124011:1.source_cn: 那么，伊戈尔怎么样？虽然他总是一通乱来……

say:14:1460124012:1.text: ...none can match his zeal among us.
say:14:1460124012:1.source_cn: 但至少他算是我们中间最有热情的那个了。

say:15:1460124013:1.text: I agree that his moves are erratic, yet in the ring, this unpredictability becomes his advantage.
say:15:1460124013:1.source_cn: 嗯，尽管他的招式难以捉摸，但在擂台上这反而是优势。

say:16:1460124014:1.text: With you leading the charge, he can strike from the shadows, unsettling the enemy. From chaos, victory may rise.
say:16:1460124014:1.source_cn: 以你作为主攻，他肆意进行袭扰，或许会达到意想不到的效果呢。

say:19:1460124015:1.text: In this case, the preliminaries here will be handled by Carolina, with Lady Valka and Igor as the main contestants.
say:19:1460124015:1.source_cn: 那么，这样的话，这里的预选赛就由卡列琳娜负责，瓦丽卡和...

say:20:1460124016:1.text: Next, let's decide on the competition format.
say:20:1460124016:1.source_cn: 接下来，你们就确定下赛制吧。

choice_prompt:21:1460124016.text: Next, let's decide on the competition format.
choice_prompt:21:1460124016.source_cn: 接下来，你们就确定下赛制吧。

say:22:1460124017:1.text: Me? Apologies, but I have no interest in this kind of endeavor.
say:22:1460124017:1.source_cn: 我？抱歉，我对这种场合全无兴趣。
say:22:1460124017:1.male: Me? Apologies, but I have no interest in this kind of endeavor.
say:22:1460124017:1.female: Me? Apologies, but I have no interest in this kind of endeavor.

choice_prompt:23:1460124017.text: Me? Apologies, but I have no interest in this kind of endeavor.
choice_prompt:23:1460124017.source_cn: 我？抱歉，我对这种场合全无兴趣。
choice_prompt:23:1460124017.male: Me? Apologies, but I have no interest in this kind of endeavor.
choice_prompt:23:1460124017.female: Me? Apologies, but I have no interest in this kind of endeavor.

say:24:1460124018:1.text: I prefer not to do this type of work, but since it's your request, I'll oblige.
say:24:1460124018:1.source_cn: ……我不喜欢做这种工作，但……既然是你请求的话。
say:24:1460124018:1.male: I prefer not to do this type of work, but since it's your request, I'll oblige.
say:24:1460124018:1.female: I prefer not to do this type of work, but since it's your request, I'll oblige.

say:25:1460124020:1.text: I will do my part... At least, this will help in building Carolina's standing among the people.
say:25:1460124020:1.source_cn: 我也应当尽一份力，就算是帮助卡列琳娜打出名声吧。
say:25:1460124020:1.male: I will do my part... At least, this will help in building Carolina's standing among the people.
say:25:1460124020:1.female: I will do my part... At least, this will help in building Carolina's standing among the people.

say:28:1460124021:1.text: Thank you so much, my lord!

say:29:1460124022:0.text: The talk takes a turn, and before long, everyone's chatting excitedly about art and design plans, all while sipping on the fresh refreshments.
say:29:1460124022:0.source_cn: 于是，大家话题一转，配着新上的茶点，开始讨论起了关于美...

say:32:1460124023:0.text: To see the legendary Graveborn with my own eyes… remarkable. Truly, a thousand miles walked teaches more than a thousand scrolls read.
say:32:1460124023:0.source_cn: 真是不可思议啊，居然亲眼目睹了传说中的亡灵，果然行万里...

choice_prompt:33:1460124023.text: To see the legendary Graveborn with my own eyes… remarkable. Truly, a thousand miles walked teaches more than a thousand scrolls read.
choice_prompt:33:1460124023.source_cn: 真是不可思议啊，居然亲眼目睹了传说中的亡灵，果然行万里路是最能增长见识的。

say:34:1460124024:0.text: I sense the opportunity is just around the corner, but there's still a little bit left to do...
say:34:1460124024:0.source_cn: 我感到契机已经近在眼前，但还差一点点……

say:35:1460124025:0.text: Just at this moment, Chippy suddenly rushes over.
say:35:1460124025:0.source_cn: 正当此时，满满突然三步并作两步地跑了过来。

say:37:1460124026:0.text: Magister! Bryon just sent word that Eironn has returned to the Dark Forest!
say:37:1460124026:0.source_cn: 主人，主人！布莱恩发来风讯了，说埃隆刚刚抵达了薄暮丛林！
say:37:1460124026:0.male: Magister! Bryon just sent word that Eironn has returned to the Dark Forest!
say:37:1460124026:0.female: Magister! Bryon just sent word that Eironn has returned to the Dark Forest!

say:38:1460124027:0.source_cn: 埃隆？太好了，他总算回家了。

say:39:1460124028:1.text: Strange how a brief wait for him allowed me to see and feel more than in all my past travels.
say:39:1460124028:1.source_cn: 真难想象，等待他的这么短的时间里，我经历的比此前旅行时...

say:40:1460124029:1.text: Master Pang seems eager to meet back up with Eironn. Let's set off early, Magister!
say:40:1460124029:1.source_cn: 潘看起来已经迫不及待想回去找埃隆叙旧了，主人，我们早些...
say:40:1460124029:1.male: Master Pang seems eager to meet back up with Eironn. Let's set off early, Magister!
say:40:1460124029:1.female: Master Pang seems eager to meet back up with Eironn. Let's set off early, Magister!

say:43:1460124030:1.text: Oh, are you leaving so soon?

say:44:1460124031:1.text: Then please allow me to entertain you all tonight. There are still many things I would like your advice on.
say:44:1460124031:1.source_cn: 那么今晚，就请让我负责招待诸位吧——还有很多很多需要指...

choice:23:0:1.text: I'd like you to design some things.
choice:23:0:1.male: I'd like you to design some things.
choice:23:0:1.female: I'd like you to design some things.

say:46:1460124019:1.text: That means not only preparing these things for the Duchy of Whiteridge but also the other locations... *Sigh*... Since it's you, I'll oblige.
say:46:1460124019:1.source_cn: 不止是白山公国，连其他地方都……好吧，既然是你的请求。
say:46:1460124019:1.male: That means not only preparing these things for the Duchy of Whiteridge but also the other locations... *Sigh*... Since it's you, I'll oblige.
say:46:1460124019:1.female: That means not only preparing these things for the Duchy of Whiteridge but also the other locations... *Sigh*... Since it's you, I'll oblige.

narration:0:1460125001:1.text: Once the preliminary match schedule is agreed upon with Carolina and her companions, you depart the Duchy of Whiteridge, though not without the Graveborn's heartfelt insistence that you linger longer.
narration:0:1460125001:1.source_cn: 与卡列琳娜他们讨论并确定了初步的赛程方案后，你们才在亡...

narration:2:1460125002:0.text: No sooner do you step beneath the Lucent Tree than your eyes fall upon a familiar figure waiting in its glow...
narration:2:1460125002:0.source_cn: 刚刚抵达流荧树下，就看到那里熟悉的身影——

say:5:1460125003:1.text: It's been a long time, my friends.

say:6:1460125004:1.text: Eironn... it has been a long road since we last met. You have changed, my friend.
say:6:1460125004:1.source_cn: 埃隆，我亲爱的朋友，好久不见……你的变化真是太大了。

say:7:1460125005:1.text: When we first met, you were a freshly drawn blade... sharp, proud, and eager to cut.
say:7:1460125005:1.source_cn: 最初见面的时候，你就像是一柄经过磨砺的崭新利剑，锋芒毕露。

say:8:1460125006:1.text: Now, you stand like an ancient tree.
say:8:1460125006:1.source_cn: 但此时此刻，你站在面前，就像是……像是一棵树一样。

say:9:1460125007:1.source_cn: 温和，冷静，但又难以摧折。

say:10:1460125008:1.text: Your words honor me, but they are more than praise.
say:10:1460125008:1.source_cn: 过奖了，而且我知道，你并不只是在称赞我。

say:11:1460125009:1.text: If I'm not mistaken, the fire in your eyes says you've come seeking to test my strength.
say:11:1460125009:1.source_cn: 如果没猜错的话，你应该已经战意熊熊了，对不对？

say:12:1460125010:1.text: You are not wrong. If I hadn't gone through this journey, I would've challenged you without hesitation.
say:12:1460125010:1.source_cn: 是。如果没有经历这段时间的旅程，想必我会毫不犹豫地与你...

say:13:1460125011:0.text: But under <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s guidance, I glimpsed sights I had never known.
say:13:1460125011:0.male: But under <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s guidance, I glimpsed sights I had never known.
say:13:1460125011:0.female: But under <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s guidance, I glimpsed sights I had never known.

say:14:1460125012:0.text: I stand like a mountain of fire... not yet awakened, but ready, waiting for the chance to rise.
say:14:1460125012:0.source_cn: 此时的我，就像是即将喷发的火山一样——仍然缺少些许契机。

say:15:1460125013:1.text: Ah, yes, I understand this feeling well. In fact, I was in this state when I first met <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:15:1460125013:1.source_cn: 嗯……我明白，事实上，在最初见到<style=stre...
say:15:1460125013:1.male: Ah, yes, I understand this feeling well. In fact, I was in this state when I first met <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:15:1460125013:1.female: Ah, yes, I understand this feeling well. In fact, I was in this state when I first met <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

say:16:1460125014:1.text: It was under his guidance that I finally found my direction and became who I am today.
say:16:1460125014:1.male: It was under his guidance that I finally found my direction and became who I am today.
say:16:1460125014:1.female: It was under her guidance that I finally found my direction and became who I am today.

choice_prompt:17:1460125014.text: It was under his guidance that I finally found my direction and became who I am today.
choice_prompt:17:1460125014.source_cn: 是在<male>他</male><female>她</female>的引导下，我才终于找到了自己的方向，从而成为了现在的我。
choice_prompt:17:1460125014.male: It was under his guidance that I finally found my direction and became who I am today.
choice_prompt:17:1460125014.female: It was under her guidance that I finally found my direction and became who I am today.

say:18:1460125015:1.text: Yes, Bryon and Lyca told me a little about what is happening.
say:18:1460125015:1.source_cn: 嗯，我在等你们的时候，已经听布莱恩和莱卡他们讲过了。

say:19:1460125016:1.text: Be it for friendship or for rivalry, step forward and test your strength!
say:19:1460125016:1.source_cn: 无论是出于友谊还是好胜心，都来试试看吧！

say:2:1460127001:0.text: When we first met, I thought your swordsmanship had reached its pinnacle.
say:2:1460127001:0.source_cn: 我原本以为当年见面时，你的剑法已经登峰造极了。

say:3:1460127002:1.text: But then you wrote of mastering the wind and ice swords, and my spirit burned with desire to follow.
say:3:1460127002:1.source_cn: 但后来你写信说，你在操控风与冰的双剑上又取得了进展，我...

say:4:1460127003:0.text: Yet now, I see you have risen even higher... beyond what I imagined.

say:8:1460130006:1.source_cn: 所以，我们就是最好的搭档，对吧，安丹德拉！你忍心看我孤...

say:9:1460130007:1.source_cn: 好吧，好吧，如果你真这么想参赛，就算我一个。

say:11:1460130009:0.text: Kruger leads the way, followed closely by Brutus, Alsa, Soren, and Mikola. They seem to be holding a meeting.

say:15:1460130011:1.text: How about we have a few spars first to warm up before we get down to talking?

choice_prompt:16:1460130011.text: How about we have a few spars first to warm up before we get down to talking?

say:24:1460130018:1.text: It would be absolutely amazing to see them here!

say:9:1460131007:1.source_cn: 在巡礼各地前，先从我们这里拿到凭证才行！
